Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Recent Theft Report

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the theft of your vehicle. At this time, we are unable to approve your request for coverage.

Our records indicate that your current policy is a liability-only plan. Therefore, it does not provide coverage for theft or damage to your own vehicle. This is based on the following policy clause: "[LIAB-2] This policy provides liability coverage only."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information you would like us to consider.

If you have any questions, please contact us directly.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
